rows.note: Use 肉 as the all-purpose choice for bodily soft tissue or animal meat; the context makes the sense clear.

example.english: The flesh of this steak is very tender.
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 ngau4 paa2 ge3 juk6 hou2 nyun6

rows.note: Use 身體 when “flesh” means the human body as a whole rather than its tissue or meat.

example.english: This disease slowly eats away at the flesh.
example.traditional: 呢種病會慢慢侵蝕人嘅身體。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 beng6 wui5 maan6 maan2 cam1 sik6 jan4 ge3 san1 tai2

rows.note: Use 果肉 specifically for the soft edible part inside a fruit.

example.english: The flesh of this peach is sweet and juicy.
example.traditional: 呢個桃嘅果肉又甜又多汁。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 tou4 ge3 gwo2 juk6 jau6 tim4 jau6 do1 zap1
